entities.name: Efrava
entities.description: An oasis in the Sukurvian desert on Jamuraa, home to the Efravan cat warriors and site of the Battle of Efrava.

entities.name: Efravans
entities.description: Tribe of tiger-like cat warriors living in Efrava.

entities.name: Jedit Ojanen
entities.description: Fought the Battle of Efrava with the Robaran Mercenaries against Johan.

entities.name: Jaeger Ojanen
entities.description: Jedit's father, who realized the tribe was stalled.

entities.name: Terrent Amese
entities.description: Creator of the cat warriors, worshiped as a god.

entities.name: Robaran Mercenaries
entities.description: Mercenaries led by Jedit in the battle.

entities.name: Battle of Efrava
entities.description: The last battle of Johan's War, fought in the air over the oasis.

entities.name: Johan's War
entities.description: War in which the Efravans became implicated.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: Where Efravan refugees were welcomed by 4562 AR.

events.summary: The Battle of Efrava is fought in the air over the oasis between airships, ending Johan's War.
events.quote: The war's last battle was the Battle of Efrava, which was fought in the air over the oasis between both sides' flying airships.

events.summary: Efrava is destroyed and the Efravan tribes scatter across Dominaria.
events.quote: Efrava had been destroyed, and the cat warrior tribes inhabiting it had scattered across Dominaria

events.summary: Efravan refugees migrate to Femeref where they are welcomed.

relations.quote: they worshiped Terrent Amese , their creator, whom they believed to be a god
